title: Sunnah Is a Handbook to Heavens - Wahabi Teachers
body:
Yaa Rabbee. Dastoor yaa Sayyidee, madad yaa rijaalAllah. (Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar. Laa ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd!
Allahu akbaru kabeera wa 'l-hamdulillahi katheera, wa subhaanallahi bukratan wa aseela. Yaa Rabbee zid
habeebika `izzan wa sharafan wa nooran wa surooran, wa ridwaana wa sultaanan wa 'l-yazhar shaanahu min
al-azaali ila 'l-abad. Huwa habeebuk, Huwa khaleefatuh! Yaa Rabbana, for his honor forgive us and bless us.
A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem.
(Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
Madad yaa RijaalAllah. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. O our Grandshaykh (q), who is responsible for
every happening on this planet, who teaches us something that we may be reaching from one level to another
level!
O our attenders from Mankind, everyone, hear and listen and obey! We are trying to make our rights for us to
be obedient, yes, obedient! O People! Now we are asking something for `ulamas for learned people.

O Salafi `ulamas and Wahabi teachers! Marhaban. From where you reached heavenly knowledge, can you
say? If you are not knowing where you are, you are going to lose your direction. Therefore it is something
important to know where you are.
Madad, yaa Sultanu 'l-Awliya! You are responsible for every event on this planet, particularly about human
nature. He has responsibility. Who understands and knows his responsibility has an honor; if not knowing,
he has no value, quickly running to the level of animals because animals have no responsibility. Therefore, it
is an important point coming now like waves from heavenly ones to make such a declaration. I am only a tap
(faucet). If they are sending, I may speak it, and if they are not sending, I don’t know anything! But you are
not accepting. You are saying, "No we are not taps, we are those people that taps and pipes are under our
control." That can't be, because to bring water we must open the tap!
O Wahabi teachers! Try to learn something and leave your bad manners because you have so many bad
manners that make people run away from Islam! Therefore, Allah Almighty is taking noor from your faces, no
lights on your faces and you look like Shaytan! Shaytan is making people run away from Islam and you are
making people hate Islam with your nonsense declarations. They run away from Islam because (of what)
Wahabi people are saying. And they are saying, "We are not accepting such an Islam!" A question to Wahabi
teachers; leave now Salafi teachers to rest tonight! ...
Madfa`iyya. My cannons, they are sending to me on their fortress. I am that one making their fortress under
my feet. And I am nothing! Wahabi teachers, what is your direction? You want to speak on it? Do you know
your direction? Do you think the Seal of Prophets (s) was using the madhhab of Wahabis? Do you think the
Seal of Prophets (s) wasn't knowing about you, about Wahabi sects (when he spoke about the division of
Muslims in the Last Days into 73 sects)? What are you, Wahabi `ulamas? This hadith is true or not?
•••• •• •••• •••• -••• •••• •••• ••••- ••• •••: •••••• •••• ••• •••• •••••• ••••
Sataftariqu ummatee `alaa thalaatha wa saba`een firqah. My nation will divide into 73 sects.
Sayyidina Muhammad (s) said, "In the future my nation will leave my way (sunnah) and my ashaab,
Companions. Through coming times will come some people who will claim the ways of my companions and
followers are wrong." (And you claim) Muhammad ibn `Abd ul-Wahhab brought the true way. From where
(based on what evidence) are you saying this, and you are only a handful of people saying billions are on the

wrong way. What is that?!
Yes, I am the weakest one, but you know that there is some virus making people to fear and it is so small they
can't even see it, and they are fearing from Pig Flu. People are trembling. They are not fearing from Allah
(swt)! (Wahabi `ulamas,) your hearts are closed to the Seal of Prophets (s) and you are saying:
•••••••••• ••••••
quloobuna ghulfoon, "Our hearts are locked." (2:88)
You say, "Our hearts are only opened by Muhammad ibn `Abd ul-Wahhab. We are never accepting what
happened." So, was Prophet (s) directing on a wrong way and `Abd ul-Wahhab is correcting him? What is
that foolishness from you?! Look at your out-looking (appearance); never are you on sunnah, not your beards
or (what you wear on) your heads or what you are dressing, in trousers and putting ties!
Do you also have a fatwa from Muhammad ibn `Abd ul-Wahhab to drive cars and take the latest model every
year, saying, "Yes, we must drive this!" Why are you not saying this? Because Muhammad ibn `Abd ulWahhab was riding on camels, so why are you not taking camels through streets of Riyadh?! Was
Muhammad ibn `Abd ul-Wahhab riding in cars or on a camel? Why are you not following him? Allah (swt) is
looking and knowing and giving His judgment for you and making your madhhab to be nothing! What are
you learning? What is your aim and your direction? To where are you directing people? `Ilm, heavenly
knowledge, is unique knowledge; is it directing people to dunya or to ahkirah? Say! Say to people, "O People,
the Lord of Heavens is directing you to dunya not to heavens!" Was that the main goal of the Seal of
Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)? (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) I know you are getting very angry when I am
standing up. If my Lord gives me in this dunya until I reach one-hundred years of age, I am asking to stand
up for the holy name of the Seal of Prophets (s)!! (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
To where was Prophet (s) directing people, to mawla or dunya? Where are you, Wahabi teachers? I am not
referring to you as`ulamas, because you know nothing! The Seal of Prophets (s) was directing people to
where you are not directing people, because you are using much more fashionable dressings. Why are you not
using servant's dressings? Why are you not putting on your heads turban, the crown of Islam, tijaan ul-Arab
and `ama`im? You know knowledge? Is that a hadith or am I writing it?

Prophet (s) is saying:
••••••• •••• •••••
al-amaimu tijan al-`arab, The turbans are crowns of Muslims, of Arabs.
Where is the Arab? Where was the Seal of Prophets (s) directing people? Where are you? And he (s) said,
khaalifu 'l-mushriqeen, khaalifu 'l-kaafireen, khalifu 'l-munaafiqeen. Why you are dressing in trousers? Why
you are putting ties? Why? Why you are not using ama`im? And if seeing a person from Ahlu’l-Sunnah
putting on his head turban, the crown of Islam, you are getting so angry. (... ) The Prophet (s) said
•• •••• •••• ••• •••• •••• ••• ••• •••• ••••
man ahya sunnatee `inda fasaada ummatee falahu ajru mi`atu shaheedin. The one who revives my sunnah in
the time of corruption will receive the reward of 100 martyrs."
Aw kamaa qaal (or as he said it). Ghalat `indakum hadha 'l-khabar (Is this transmission considered wrong by
you) or you are saying mawdu` (forged) ? You are mawdu`! Inshaa-Allah, I am weakest one for the ummah,
but I am making your no-madhhab way under my feet!!
Al-`amaaimu tijaan ul-`arab. If you are looking at someone (with a turban) you become so scared of him,
saying, "Why putting this? They are 'ahl al bida`', people of innovation." Antum ahl as-sunnah? (But) are you
people of sunnah? Where is your crown? No crowns? Do you understand Holy Qur'an? Holy Qur'an is saying,
for the Battle of Badr, Allah Almighty, yamuddu ashaab an-nabi bi 'l-malaaikati munazzaleen,
mussawameen. "Supported the Companions by causing angels to descend," because that day angels came
from heavens on their horses and, mussawwameen, the edge of their turbans was like this (Mawlana tucks in
the tail of his turban.) When Prophet (s) saw this, he also tucked the edge of his turban, saying, li ashaabihi:
•••• •• ••••• ••• •••• •••• •••• ••• ••••••• ••• ••• : •••••• ••• •••••••• •• ••••• •••••• •••••• •• ••••••• ••••••••
tassawwamu fa inna 'l-malaa`ikatu qad tassawamat. O my Companions! Do as the angels and make tails for
your turbans!
You are knowing something? Not knowing anything! Someone to teach you and you are not happy with that
one.

O Wahabi teachers! Happy or unhappy, it doesn't matter. This is heavenly declaration. To where are you
directing people, to dunya or to mawla? All of you are working for dunya, not for mawla. (Mawlana Shaykh
stands) The Seal of Prophets (s) directed his nation to heavens, not to dunya but to mawla! (Mawlana Shaykh
sits.) Try to learn, Wahabi teachers and Wahabi followers. Try to understand, an `arabiyaat qaleel, my Arabic
language is very short, but you can understand. May Allah (swt) forgive us.
O People! You must know your true life direction before you can teach others their true life direction. That is
real knowledge, that angels are saying, "O our Lord, grant to that servant as You like." May Allah forgive me
and you also. We must come together hand-in-hand to make Shaytan and it's sultanate under our feet! That
is our aim, nothing else.
(32 minutes)
Yes sir, I know nothing. I know nothing. He knows and His representative, Habeebullah (s) knows and his
inheritors (awliyaullah) know. But my level is zero level and I am bombarding on those who are on zero level.
I am not claiming they are on another level, no; they are on the same level. Therefore, I am bombarding them!
(Mawlana Shaykh speaks to Shaykh Hisham Effendi on the phone.)
